title: NASA Science
explanation:
# A 3D Window into Lunar History

Put on red and blue glasses and step onto the Moon's Ocean of Storms in November 1969, where astronaut Pete Conrad stands beside Surveyor 3, a robotic explorer that had waited alone on the lunar surface for two and a half years. This stunning 3D image was created from two photos taken just inches apart—mimicking how your two eyes see the world in depth—revealing the nearby crater wall and the Apollo 12 spacecraft sitting tantalizingly close, less than a football field away.
